newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan overnight rates remain volatile.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan overnight rates remain volatile.

text.p: Pakistan's overnight rates remained volatile on Thursday, fluctuating between 11 and 19 percent, dealers said.

Early deals were struck around 19 percent and later bids and offers were seen at 12 and 17 percent respectively, a dealer at Khadim Ali Shah Bukhari and Co said. The overnight rates fell to 11 percent before the close.
Bids and offers for one-week repos were quoted at 18 and 19.50 percent respectively, he said.
